text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- German bank Commerzbank increases stake in Banque Commerciale du Maroc to 10 percent from 1.6 percent.
- Casablanca seminar on strategy to face the challenge of a European Union-Moroccan free trade zone examines ways to ensure pragmatic partnership.
- MPs might hold special session to discuss draft electoral law and regionalisation.
- Spanish agriculture minister's visit focused on fishing accord between Morocco and the European Union. The accord allows some 600 vessels mainly Spanish to operate in Moroccan waters.
- U.N. General-Secretary Kofi Annan says presence in Western Sahara from July to 1997 to August 1998 will cost $29 million.
- Danger of locusts loom in eastern part of Morocco.
- Morocco and Spain agree on a more rational management of fish resources.
- Cost of food products increases by only 0.7 percent in 1996 compared with the year before.
- New prospects of trade with Iraq after embargo has been lifted in December last year in favour of the food-for-oil plan.
